sources.title: 《舊唐書》卷79呂才傳〈敘祿命〉四庫系受讀
sources.quality_notes: Narrative dates the completed official yin-yang book editing to Zhenguan 15 (641), 53 new and 47 old juan. Reports five critiques with birth fields and terms; no original Tang folio or verified birth records.

sources.title: 《新唐書》卷107呂才傳〈祿命篇〉四庫系受讀
sources.quality_notes: Retells 53 and 47 as pian; Qin king designation and some wording differ, e.g. adds 身克驛馬 in Lu case. Related historiographical witnesses not independent Tang physical copies.

sources.title: 沈括《夢溪筆談》卷八〈象數二〉四庫系受讀
sources.quality_notes: Explicitly names Lü Cai and discusses divergent outcomes by practitioner; agrees on objections to surname and five sounds. Not proof of specific natal rule transmission or predictive accuracy.

nodes_added_or_strengthened: Lü Cai's Tang editing project and received critique; Shen Kuo's Northern Song response (report scope, graph unchanged)
edges_supported: Shen Kuo explicitly refers to Lü Cai's three critiques; intellectual reception only
edges_rejected_or_unproved: No direct line to Li Xuzhong, Xu Ziping, or Ziwei; no complete four-pillar/day-master method
No predictive validation from historical anecdotes
unresolved_lineage_questions: Collate dated editions and locate early manuscript/print for both Tang histories and Mengxi Bitan; resolve 53/47 unit and Qin king designation; identify exact cited natal book and recover formulas if extant.
